killedBy: the screen-state catalogue seeds the DEVELOPER key namespace on every state whose URL carries the dev gate
why: Seeds a PRODUCTION save on a state whose URL carries the dev gate. Issue #245 selects the storage namespace from `location.search` at boot, so a `?dev=1` page persists behind `tanks.dev.` and cannot see those keys at all -- the capture boots a first-time player, and its own recipe then times out clicking a Continue that is not offered. MEASURED: this is exactly what the five ending states did on their first run, and it presents as a broken recipe rather than as a namespace rule, which is why the catalogue now asserts the pairing in both directions.
